 Print Picture Credit: Instagram Actor Samantha Ruth Prabhu has shared pictures from an intimate ceremony at home as she and her husband, filmmaker Raj Nidimoru will be welcoming their first child. The pictures show the couple taking part in traditional rituals, with elders from both families gathering to bless the mom-to-be. Samantha Ruth Prabhu shares pictures from home ceremony 
 Samantha Ruth Prabhu shared the pictures on her Instagram handle where she can be seen wearing a red Anarkali suit. In one photograph, she and Raj are seen looking at each other as they sit together during the ceremony. Other pictures capture the couple participating in the rituals with their family members. Watch Samantha Ruth Prabhu Speaks From The Heart; Actress Opens Up On Self-growth Another picture shows elders placing their hands over Samantha's head as they bless her. The actor also shared a picture with her mother, Ninette Prabhu, and posed with the women from both families. Join conversation

 Samantha documents her fitness journey during pregnancy 
 On October 30, Samantha shared a video on Instagram documenting her fitness journey during pregnancy. The clip featured the actress working out at different stages, from her first month to the ninth. In one glimpse, she was seen performing weighted squats while holding a dumbbell close to her chest. Samantha Ruth Prabhu and Raj Nidimoru celebrated a traditional Seemantham ceremony in September. The occasion also included Kalaa Aavarana (Sri Kalpam), a specialised ritual from the Srividya tradition. The couple tied the knot on December 1, 2025, in an intimate ceremony at the Isha Yoga Centre in Coimbatore. Samantha Ruth Prabhu’s work front
 Samantha Ruth Prabhu was last seen in the family action drama ‘Maa Inti Bangaaram’ directed by Nandini Reddy and created by Raj Nidimoru. The film became a huge hit during its theatrical run and went over to touch Rs. 100 crore mark worldwide. Samantha Ruth Prabhu confirmed her pregnancy in June this year at the success meet of her film ‘Maa Inti Bangaaram’ in Hyderabad. Interestingly, she was pregnant while shooting for the project. She is currently hosting the culinary reality show ‘Celebrity MasterChef Tamil’. After her maternity break she is expected to work on the show ‘Rakt Brahmand: The Bloody Kingdom’.
